items.heading: Smorrebrod
details: Key ingredients: rye bread, butter, herring or roast beef, toppings
Spread a thick layer of butter on dense rye bread.
Layer with pickled herring, roast beef or other toppings.
Garnish carefully with pickles, herbs or fried onions.
Serve open-faced, eaten with a knife and fork.

items.heading: Frikadeller
details: Key ingredients: ground pork and veal, onion, egg, breadcrumbs
Mix ground pork and veal with grated onion, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shape the mixture into oval patties.
Fry in butter until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve with boiled potatoes and gravy or pickled red cabbage.
